predictions.rationale: Provides the notation rendering for the body of a UML State element, directly affecting how states appear in state diagrams.
Handles notation for Action-States, a key graphical element specific to state diagrams.
Implements the textual/graphical notation for Call-States which are used only in state diagrams.
Explorer rule that explicitly navigates from a model element to its owning State Diagram, indicating knowledge of the diagram type.
Maps a UML StateMachine to its associated diagram, strongly tying the file to state-diagram infrastructure.
Provides navigation from a classifier to its state machine, an essential model element underlying state diagrams.
Defines notation for Transitions, the arcs between states that are central to state-diagram semantics.
Explorer rule that expands a state machine into its contained States, reflecting the diagram’s structural hierarchy.
Focuses on the guard condition of a Transition within a state machine/diagram, showing close coupling to state-diagram concepts.
Navigates from a state machine to its top-level composite state, part of browsing and editing state diagrams.
